text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia (with neutropenia and lymphopenia), elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin), mild renal impairment (creatinine high), and prolonged INR. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible bone marrow suppression or consumption, and impaired oxygenation. Clinical correlation is recommended to rule out severe infection, sepsis, or other acute systemic illness. Immediate clinical evaluation is advised.
